subject: M0 setup report from onboarding
body: Worked: board printed at SessionStart; claim; edit guard blocked tools/guard-test.txt and named coord. Papercut: the session starts on claude/awesome-wright-ciik1f, and claim records the currently checked-out branch, so the board showed onboarding on the coord branch until I created lane/onboarding and re-ran claim. Suggest claim warn when branch != lane/<lane>, or the kickoff say to check out lane/<lane> first. Doc conflict: calibration length is ~20 s/emotion in lanes/onboarding.md, ~60 s in coord/lanes.json, 30 s total in the mvp.md demo table; I chose 20 s (D-onboarding-004); please align lanes.json if you agree.
